sloka: ततः पादपमुक्तेन पुष्पवर्षेण वीर्यवान् ।अभिवृष्टः स्थितस्तत्र बभौ पुष्पमयो यथा ॥५-२-२॥
transliteration: tataḥ pādapamuktena puṣpavarṣeṇa vīryavān ।abhivṛṣṭaḥ sthitastatra babhau puṣpamayo yathā ॥5-2-2॥

translations.english: Covered fully with the continuous shower of flowers dropped on him from the trees, heroic Hanuman appeared as though he was a heap of flowers as he stood there.
